# Platform Operations & SRE

**For:** Hiring managers and engineers looking for infrastructure, platform, DevOps or site reliability experience.

Self-hosted clusters, isolation boundaries, provisioning automation and the operational tooling that keeps them observable and recoverable.

## Role glossary

### B

**Backpressure**  
Slowing or shedding incoming work when a downstream stage is full, instead of letting queues grow until something breaks.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md), [02 EPOS TCP Proxy Middleware](../../projects/02-epos-tcp-proxy-middleware/profile.md), [24 ChatOps Telemetry Microservice](../../projects/24-automated-chatops-telemetry-microservice/profile.md)  

### C

**ChatOps**  
Running operational alerts and actions through team chat so the whole team sees system state where they already work.  
*Projects:* [24 ChatOps Telemetry Microservice](../../projects/24-automated-chatops-telemetry-microservice/profile.md)  

**Copy-on-Write (CoW) Snapshots**  
Filesystem snapshots (here ZFS) that share unchanged blocks, so a fresh sandbox can be cloned in seconds and thrown away cleanly.  
*Projects:* [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md)  

### D

**Data Sovereignty**  
Keeping control of where data and code live and who can reach them, enforced by architecture (self-hosting, isolation, mirrors) rather than by vendor policy.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [19 Git Mirror Automation](../../projects/19-sovereign-git-continuous-mirror-automation/profile.md), [22 Social Enterprise Portal](../../projects/22-non-profit-community-social-enterprise-portal/profile.md), [26 Portfolio Engine](../../projects/26-principal-systems-engineering-portfolio/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md)  

**DEFCON 0 (Zero-Egress Containment)**  
This portfolio's name for a sandbox whose outbound internet access is dropped at the host firewall by default and only allowed through named, isolated tunnels.  
*Projects:* [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md), [26 Portfolio Engine](../../projects/26-principal-systems-engineering-portfolio/profile.md)  

### E

**Edge Ingress (Reverse Proxy)**  
The front door (Caddy, Nginx) that terminates TLS, applies limits and routes traffic before it reaches application services.  
*Projects:* [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](../../projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md), [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [12 Consultancy Routing Portal](../../projects/12-unified-multi-tenant-consultancy-routing-portal/profile.md), [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  

**Ephemeral Toolchain**  
Running build tools inside throwaway containers so nothing is installed on the host and every run starts from the same state.  
*Projects:* [23 Shopify Storefront Engine](../../projects/23-containerized-ecommerce-design-system/profile.md), [26 Portfolio Engine](../../projects/26-principal-systems-engineering-portfolio/profile.md), [09 Geospatial Stream Dashboard](../../projects/09-geospatial-live-stream-intelligence-dashboard/profile.md), [24 ChatOps Telemetry Microservice](../../projects/24-automated-chatops-telemetry-microservice/profile.md)  

**Exponential Backoff**  
Waiting progressively longer between retries after a rate-limit or failure response, so clients recover without hammering the service.  
*Projects:* [24 ChatOps Telemetry Microservice](../../projects/24-automated-chatops-telemetry-microservice/profile.md), [19 Git Mirror Automation](../../projects/19-sovereign-git-continuous-mirror-automation/profile.md), [11 Headless Scraping Cluster](../../projects/11-distributed-headless-scraping-cluster/profile.md)  

### F

**Fail-Open**  
Choosing to pass traffic through unchanged when an optional processing step fails, because stopping service costs more than skipping the step.  
*Projects:* [02 EPOS TCP Proxy Middleware](../../projects/02-epos-tcp-proxy-middleware/profile.md)  

### G

**GPU Passthrough**  
Giving a container or VM direct, fenced access to a physical GPU (or a slice of one) for local model inference.  
*Projects:* [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md)  

### I

**Idempotent Provisioning**  
Setup scripts that can be re-run safely and converge on the same result, usually guarded by pre-flight checks.  
*Projects:* [20 LXD Clustering Toolkit](../../projects/20-automated-lxd-clustering-provisioning-toolkit/profile.md), [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md)  

**Infrastructure as Code (OpenTofu, Ansible)**  
Declaring infrastructure in versioned files so environments are reproducible, reviewable and checked for drift.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  

### L

**LXD System Containers**  
Containers that run a full Linux userland like a lightweight VM. Run unprivileged, they are the main isolation unit across these projects.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [20 LXD Clustering Toolkit](../../projects/20-automated-lxd-clustering-provisioning-toolkit/profile.md), [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  

### N

**Network Namespace Egress**  
Forcing a workload's outbound traffic through a dedicated network namespace and tunnel (WireGuard, Tailscale) so it never touches the host's WAN address.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md)  

### O

**Observability**  
Metrics, probes and dashboards (Prometheus, Grafana, Gatus) that show whether a system is healthy without logging into it.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [24 ChatOps Telemetry Microservice](../../projects/24-automated-chatops-telemetry-microservice/profile.md)  

**OIDC Single Sign-On**  
Central identity (here Authentik) that every internal service trusts, instead of each keeping its own passwords.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md)  

### P

**Process Supervision (Watchdog)**  
An external health check that restarts hung or leaking workers automatically (here through PM2).  
*Projects:* [11 Headless Scraping Cluster](../../projects/11-distributed-headless-scraping-cluster/profile.md)  

**Pull Mirror**  
A self-hosted copy of a repository that keeps fetching from the original, so code survives an upstream outage or account loss.  
*Projects:* [19 Git Mirror Automation](../../projects/19-sovereign-git-continuous-mirror-automation/profile.md)  

### R

**Raft Consensus**  
A protocol that keeps cluster nodes agreeing on state as long as a majority (quorum) is reachable.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md)  

**RCON (Remote Console)**  
A game-server administration protocol, kept off the public internet here behind an authenticated web bridge.  
*Projects:* [18 Game Server RCON Orchestrator](../../projects/18-dedicated-game-server-rcon-orchestrator/profile.md)  

### S

**Secret Brokerage (OpenBao)**  
Issuing short-lived credentials to workloads at runtime instead of storing keys on disk or in environment files.  
*Projects:* [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md)  

### W

**Workload Sharding**  
Splitting a large job (here IP ranges) into deterministic pieces that can run in parallel across machines.  
*Projects:* [10 Network Recon Pipeline](../../projects/10-high-throughput-network-recon-pipeline/profile.md)  

### Z

**Zero-Downtime Deployment**  
Releasing a new version without dropping users, for example by rolling containers over a private network.  
*Projects:* [08 Workforce Scheduling Engine](../../projects/08-enterprise-workforce-scheduling-engine/profile.md)  

**Zero-Trust Networking**  
Treating every request as untrusted until identity is verified, regardless of which network it comes from.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](../../projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md)
